_comment: Bulgarian month names are the international Latin-derived set, like Serbian and Russian and UNLIKE Czech (leden), Croatian (siječanj), Polish (styczeń) and Ukrainian (січень), which kept the Slavic nature-names. They are written LOWERCASE. monthsInDate is identical to months, and that identity is a fact about the grammar rather than a shortcut: Bulgarian is the one Slavic language with no noun cases at all, so there is no genitive for a date to switch into — 16 август 2026 г. carries the same form as the bare month name, where Czech would write 16. srpna. The formats end in " г." (за година): a Bulgarian date is conventionally closed with that abbreviation, both in the numeric and in the long form.
